draft.title: Effective annual interest rate
card: A nominal rate is the yearly rate that is quoted. If it is compounded more often than once a year, the balance grows by more than the nominal rate over the year.

The effective annual rate is the single yearly rate that gives the same growth in one year. Formula: r(eff) = (1 + r/(100n))^n − 1, then × 100 for a percentage. Here r is the nominal rate in % and n is the number of compounding periods per year.
Example: 6% compounded quarterly. Each quarter earns 6 ÷ 4 = 1.5%. After one year the balance is 1.015⁴ = 1.0614 times the start, so the effective rate is about 6.14%.
More frequent compounding gives a higher effective rate. Compounding once a year gives an effective rate equal to the nominal rate.
draft.remember: Effective rate = growth factor over one year, minus 1. More compounding means a higher effective rate.

a.q: A savings account pays 4% per year, compounded annually. What is its effective annual interest rate?
a.why: With one compounding period a year, the balance grows by exactly 4% in a year, so the effective rate equals the nominal rate. 4.04% would be the rate if compounding were twice a year.
a.clue: How many times a year is the interest added?

b.q: Mia's account pays 6% per year, compounded monthly. Her friend Sam's account pays 6% per year, compounded quarterly. Which statement is correct?
opts: Mia's effective rate is higher than Sam's
Sam's effective rate is higher than Mia's
Both have an effective rate of exactly 6%
Both have the same effective rate above 6%
b.why: Both nominal rates are 6%, but monthly compounding adds interest to the balance more often than quarterly does. Mia's effective rate is about 6.17% and Sam's is about 6.14%. The equal nominal rate is the tempting trap, as it does not make the effective rates equal.
b.clue: Compare how often interest is added to the balance.

b.best: Mia's effective rate is higher than Sam's

check.summary: No problems found. The figures 6.14%, 6.17% and 4.04% are correct, and the formula and explanations match the card.
